claims.text: Inadequate response to antidepressant monotherapy: augment w lithium
claims.quote: In instances where monotherapy for depression proves inadequate, it is advisable to augment the existing antidepressant regimen with lithium.

claims.text: If adding an atypical antipsychotic fails: esketamine or other augmenting agents such as lithium, modafinil or triiodothyronine (T3)
claims.quote: And esketamine or other augmentation agents like lithium, modafinil or triiodothyronine (T3) can be augmented if adding AAP is not effective
claims.locator: Korean Medication Algorithm Project for Depressive Disorder 2025: comparison with other guidelines (Clin Psychopharmacol Neurosci, 2026)
